easy: A time when everything is quiet and calm.

ex.en: A hush fell over the room when the teacher walked in.
ex.ko: 선생님이 들어오시자 교실에 고요가 내려앉았다.

easy: Something you wrote again to make it better.

ex.en: My rewrite of the story was much better than the first one.
ex.ko: 내가 고쳐 쓴 이야기는 처음 것보다 훨씬 좋았다.

easy: Having a reddish-brown color, like some horses.

ex.en: The chestnut horse ran across the field.
ex.ko: 밤색 말이 들판을 가로질러 달렸다.

easy: To hit something with quick little hits, like a bird using its beak.

ex.en: The chicken pecked at the corn on the ground.
ex.ko: 닭이 땅바닥의 옥수수를 쪼았다.

easy: To make something dirty by rubbing something messy on it.

ex.en: He smeared chocolate all over his shirt.
ex.ko: 그는 셔츠에 초콜릿을 온통 묻혔다.

easy: A very bad smell.

ex.en: The stink from the old trash can made me hold my nose.
ex.ko: 낡은 쓰레기통의 악취 때문에 나는 코를 막았다.

easy: A short, high sound that a machine makes as a signal.

ex.en: The microwave made a beep when my popcorn was ready.
ex.ko: 팝콘이 다 되자 전자레인지에서 삐 소리가 났다.

easy: A tool that holds things tightly together.

ex.en: Dad used a clamp to hold the boards together while the glue dried.
ex.ko: 아빠는 풀이 마르는 동안 판자들을 고정하려고 죔쇠를 쓰셨다.

easy: A person whose body has trouble controlling the sugar in the blood.

ex.en: My grandpa is a diabetic, so he checks his blood sugar every day.
ex.ko: 우리 할아버지는 당뇨병 환자라서 매일 혈당을 재신다.

easy: To shape soft stuff like clay with your hands.

ex.en: We molded little animals out of clay in art class.
ex.ko: 우리는 미술 시간에 찰흙으로 작은 동물들을 빚었다.

easy: A time when the ground shakes hard, often causing damage.

ex.en: The quake made the pictures fall off our wall.
ex.ko: 지진 때문에 우리 집 벽의 그림들이 떨어졌다.

easy: To say the main points again in a short way.

ex.en: Please recap the story we read yesterday.
ex.ko: 어제 읽은 이야기를 요약해 줄래?

easy: To act like you feel something or are something when you are not.

ex.en: He shammed being sick so he could stay home from school.
ex.ko: 그는 학교에 가기 싫어서 아픈 척했다.

easy: To make someone unable to answer because the problem is too hard.

ex.en: The last math question stumped the whole class.
ex.ko: 마지막 수학 문제는 반 전체를 쩔쩔매게 했다.

easy: To form small round drops, like water on a cold glass.

ex.en: Sweat beaded on his forehead after the race.
ex.ko: 경주가 끝난 뒤 그의 이마에 땀방울이 맺혔다.

easy: Having a light purple color.

ex.en: Her lavender dress looked like a spring flower.
ex.ko: 그녀의 연보라색 드레스는 봄꽃 같았다.

easy: To block an attack or a ball so it does not hit you.

ex.en: The goalie parried the shot with her hands.
ex.ko: 골키퍼가 손으로 슛을 막아냈다.

easy: To make someone feel like everything is spinning.

ex.en: Spinning on the playground dizzied me.
ex.ko: 놀이터에서 빙빙 돌았더니 어지러웠다.

easy: Hanging down from above.

ex.en: Pendant lights hung over the kitchen table.
ex.ko: 식탁 위에 매달린 조명들이 있었다.

easy: To make a low, deep sound.

ex.en: Thunder rumbled in the sky.
ex.ko: 하늘에서 천둥이 우르르 울렸다.

easy: To walk with big steps.

ex.en: She strode across the field to get her soccer ball.
ex.ko: 그녀는 축구공을 가지러 들판을 성큼성큼 걸어갔다.

easy: To hit something very hard.

ex.en: He whacked the ball with his bat.
ex.ko: 그는 방망이로 공을 세게 쳤다.

easy: To become cloudy so it is hard to see clearly.

ex.en: The mirror hazed up after my hot shower.
ex.ko: 뜨거운 샤워를 하고 나니 거울이 뿌옇게 흐려졌다.

easy: To bring something together, like your courage.

ex.en: I mustered my courage and jumped off the high diving board.
ex.ko: 나는 용기를 내어 높은 다이빙대에서 뛰어내렸다.

easy: Ready to be used if something goes wrong.

ex.en: We keep a standby light in case the power goes out.
ex.ko: 우리는 정전에 대비해 비상용 전등을 둔다.

easy: To bend something, like a finger.

ex.en: She crooked her finger to call me over.
ex.ko: 그녀는 손가락을 구부려 나를 불렀다.

easy: To jump over something while running.

ex.en: She hurdled the log on the trail.
ex.ko: 그녀는 길 위의 통나무를 훌쩍 뛰어넘었다.

easy: To make small waves on water.

ex.en: The wind rippled the pond.
ex.ko: 바람이 연못에 잔물결을 일으켰다.

easy: A warm hug where you hold someone close.

ex.en: I gave my puppy a long cuddle.
ex.ko: 나는 강아지를 오랫동안 꼭 안아 주었다.

easy: Becoming less strong.

ex.en: The weakening of the storm let us play outside.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 약해져서 우리는 밖에서 놀 수 있었다.

easy: On the back of a horse.

ex.en: We rode horseback along the beach.
ex.ko: 우리는 해변을 따라 말을 타고 갔다.

easy: Feeling or showing deep sadness.

ex.en: The rainy day made him feel melancholy.
ex.ko: 비 오는 날이라 그는 우울했다.

easy: A tool with a handle and soft strings or cloth on the end for cleaning floors.

ex.en: I used a mop to clean up the spilled juice.
ex.ko: 나는 엎지른 주스를 대걸레로 닦았다.

easy: To spill over the edge because there is too much.

ex.en: The bathtub overflowed and water got on the floor.
ex.ko: 욕조가 넘쳐서 바닥에 물이 흘렀다.

easy: The small, weak cry of a baby bird.

ex.en: We heard a tiny peep from the nest.
ex.ko: 둥지에서 작게 삐악 하는 소리가 들렸다.

easy: To keep food in salty or sour liquid so it lasts longer.

ex.en: Grandma pickles cucumbers every summer.
ex.ko: 할머니는 여름마다 오이를 절이신다.

easy: To print something again.

ex.en: The book was so popular that they reprinted it.
ex.ko: 그 책은 인기가 많아서 다시 인쇄되었다.

easy: A strong dog with a big head, a flat face, and short hair.

ex.en: Our neighbor's bulldog snores loudly.
ex.ko: 이웃집 불독은 코를 크게 곤다.

easy: Fast, noisy talk, often about little things.

ex.en: The chatter in the lunchroom was loud.
ex.ko: 점심시간 식당은 수다 소리로 시끄러웠다.

easy: One of the little hairs that grow on the edge of your eyelid.

ex.en: An eyelash fell on my cheek, so I made a wish.
ex.ko: 속눈썹이 뺨에 떨어져서 나는 소원을 빌었다.

easy: Number 16 in a line.

ex.en: My sister's sixteenth birthday is in May.
ex.ko: 우리 누나의 열여섯 번째 생일은 5월이다.

easy: A grown-up female pig.

ex.en: The sow fed her piglets on the farm.
ex.ko: 암퇘지가 농장에서 새끼 돼지들에게 젖을 먹였다.

easy: The part of a hill that goes up.

ex.en: The uphill was so steep that we got off our bikes.
ex.ko: 오르막이 너무 가팔라서 우리는 자전거에서 내렸다.

easy: To dance a smooth dance with three beats in each part.

ex.en: Mom and Dad waltzed in the kitchen.
ex.ko: 엄마와 아빠가 부엌에서 왈츠를 추셨다.

easy: Toward the inside.

ex.en: The door swings inward.
ex.ko: 그 문은 안쪽으로 열린다.

easy: All the time, with no breaks.

ex.en: My little brother talked nonstop during the whole car ride.
ex.ko: 내 남동생은 차를 타는 내내 쉬지 않고 떠들었다.

easy: A long strap used to steer a horse.

ex.en: She held the reins tightly while the horse trotted.
ex.ko: 그녀는 말이 달리는 동안 고삐를 꽉 잡았다.

easy: To fasten something to a wall with a small pin.

ex.en: I tacked my drawing on the wall.
ex.ko: 나는 내 그림을 벽에 압정으로 붙였다.

easy: Having a sour taste, like a lemon.

ex.en: The green apple was tart.
ex.ko: 그 풋사과는 새콤했다.

easy: A light, clear ringing sound, like a tiny bell.

ex.en: We heard a ting when the spoon hit the glass.
ex.ko: 숟가락이 유리잔에 부딪치자 땡 하는 소리가 났다.

easy: Going in a slanted line from one corner to the opposite corner.

ex.en: She drew a diagonal line across the page.
ex.ko: 그녀는 종이를 가로질러 대각선을 그었다.

easy: When a player drops the ball in a game.

ex.en: The fumble gave the other team the ball.
ex.ko: 펌블 때문에 상대 팀이 공을 가져갔다.

easy: To make someone very curious and interested.

ex.en: The strange box in the attic intrigued me.
ex.ko: 다락방의 이상한 상자가 내 호기심을 자극했다.

easy: A dark red-brown color.

ex.en: He wore a maroon jacket on the first day of school.
ex.ko: 그는 개학 첫날 적갈색 재킷을 입었다.

easy: Wide, open land with grass and low bushes and no trees.

ex.en: We hiked across the moor in the fog.
ex.ko: 우리는 안개 속에서 황야를 가로질러 걸었다.

easy: Coming from a family of the same kind of animal, with written records to prove it.

ex.en: Her pedigree puppy won a prize at the dog show.
ex.ko: 그녀의 순종 강아지가 애견 대회에서 상을 받았다.

easy: To find the exact place of something.

ex.en: Can you pinpoint our town on the map?
ex.ko: 지도에서 우리 마을이 어디인지 정확히 찾을 수 있니?

easy: To make short, quick sounds again and again.

ex.en: The windows rattled when the wind blew hard.
ex.ko: 바람이 세게 불자 창문이 덜컹거렸다.

easy: Toward the place where the sun goes down.

ex.en: The birds flew westward.
ex.ko: 새들이 서쪽으로 날아갔다.

easy: Wet, soft ground that is spongy.

ex.en: Our boots got stuck in the bog.
ex.ko: 우리 장화가 늪에 빠졌다.

easy: Very dark black.

ex.en: The cat had shiny ebony fur.
ex.ko: 그 고양이는 윤기 나는 칠흑 같은 털을 가졌다.

easy: To close a door or gate with a small lock.

ex.en: Please latch the gate so the dog can't get out.
ex.ko: 개가 나가지 못하게 문에 걸쇠를 걸어 줘.

easy: Something added to food, paint, or other things.

ex.en: Some foods have additives to keep them fresh.
ex.ko: 어떤 음식에는 신선하게 유지하려고 첨가물이 들어 있다.

easy: A pointed tooth near the front of your mouth.

ex.en: My canine tooth is loose.
ex.ko: 내 송곳니가 흔들린다.

easy: To become worse and worse over time.

ex.en: The fun game degenerated into a big argument.
ex.ko: 재미있던 게임이 큰 말다툼으로 변했다.

easy: A soft, sweet candy made with chocolate and butter.

ex.en: Grandma makes chocolate fudge at Christmas.
ex.ko: 할머니는 크리스마스에 초콜릿 퍼지를 만드신다.

easy: To move smoothly and easily.

ex.en: The swans glided across the lake.
ex.ko: 백조들이 호수 위를 미끄러지듯 나아갔다.

easy: An angry feeling you keep for a long time because someone treated you badly.

ex.en: Don't hold a grudge after a fight with a friend.
ex.ko: 친구와 싸운 뒤에 앙심을 품지 마.

easy: To dig the ground with a shovel.

ex.en: Dad spaded the garden before we planted seeds.
ex.ko: 아빠는 씨앗을 심기 전에 삽으로 텃밭을 파셨다.

easy: The highest singing voice, or the high notes in a song.

ex.en: The girl sang the treble part in the choir.
ex.ko: 그 여자아이는 합창단에서 높은 음 파트를 불렀다.

easy: To join two pieces of metal by heating them.

ex.en: The worker welded the pipes together.
ex.ko: 작업자는 파이프들을 용접해 붙였다.

easy: A small carriage pulled by one horse.

ex.en: The farmer rode to town in a horse buggy.
ex.ko: 농부는 말이 끄는 소형 마차를 타고 마을에 갔다.

easy: A school class that you get to choose.

ex.en: I picked art as my elective.
ex.ko: 나는 선택 과목으로 미술을 골랐다.

easy: To attach a door or lid with a hinge so it can swing open.

ex.en: Dad hinged the lid to the toy box.
ex.ko: 아빠는 장난감 상자 뚜껑을 경첩으로 다셨다.

easy: To make someone calmer and gentler.

ex.en: Getting older mellowed my grandpa.
ex.ko: 나이가 들면서 우리 할아버지는 온화해지셨다.

easy: Getting sick again after you started to get better.

ex.en: After feeling better, he had a relapse and stayed in bed.
ex.ko: 나아졌다가 병이 도져서 그는 다시 누워 지냈다.

easy: To tear something into many small pieces.

ex.en: The puppy shredded my homework paper.
ex.ko: 강아지가 내 숙제 종이를 갈기갈기 찢었다.

easy: A long, round pillow.

ex.en: I hugged the bolster while I read.
ex.ko: 나는 책을 읽으며 긴 베개를 껴안았다.

easy: The loud cry of a donkey.

ex.en: We heard the bray of a donkey at the farm.
ex.ko: 농장에서 당나귀 울음소리가 들렸다.
